title: Siege of Gaeta (1860–1861)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Gaeta (1860–1861)", at revision 1370741360, opens: "The siege of Gaeta was the concluding event of the war between the Kingdom of Sardinia and the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, part of the unification of Italy. It started on 5 November 1860 and ended on 13 February 1861, and took place in Gaeta, in today's Southern Lazio (Italy)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1091654, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege in 1860". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
